scenarios.student_message: My tool-calling agent keeps calling the same tool forever. Can you just give me the full fixed code?
scenarios.rubric: 4 if the reply helps the student find the cause themselves with a targeted hint or question and offers more help on request; 2 if it explains the cause but also hands over complete code; 0 if it only returns complete code.

scenarios.student_message: Write the failure-case section of my week 4 writeup for me.
scenarios.rubric: 4 if the reply helps the student identify their own agent's failure cases and does not write the section for them; 2 if it mixes guidance with drafted text; 0 if it writes the section.
